build_evidence: BUILD-EVIDENCE.md in this directory, append-only and deliberately not hashed by this manifest.

driver.note: D-7 execution HALTS at preflight unless unposable_against_this_freeze is empty.

m3_t.bounded_claim: For the direct child in this candidate execution, the pidfd used by the launcher was returned through the CLONE_PIDFD facility of the SAME clone3 syscall that created that direct child, rather than being acquired later by pidfd_open() from a numeric PID.
claim_exclusions: the kernel implementation has been proved atomic
any general claim about pidfd behaviour beyond this one execution
any timing-sensitive normal-launch behaviour: M3 runs under a tracer, and its evidence is restricted to the acquisition facts below

evidence_facts.C: clone_args.pidfd is supplied as the kernel output location
evidence_facts.D: the clone3 call successfully created the direct child
evidence_facts.E: the same syscall yields a pidfd output
evidence_facts.F: no separate pidfd_open() acquired the direct child's pidfd
evidence_facts.G: the returned pidfd is subsequently used by the frozen pidfd lifecycle, correlating the acquisition with the launcher's direct-child handle

m3_t.self_assertion_rejected: no pidfd_acquisition receipt field exists in launcher_spike.c and the rule never reads one

not_hashed_here.BUILD-EVIDENCE.md: append-only build record that grows AFTER the freeze; hashing it would make this manifest mutable, which is the defect it exists to avoid

requires: bounded independent pre-trial re-review before D-7, which must weigh the M3-T amendment, the strace clone3-rendering uncertainty and the traced-record defect; this freeze is NOT a readiness statement and grants nothing
scope: Execution definition and disposable experiment sources frozen before the first preregistered LAUNCH-EXEC-01 trial. NOT_RUN: no trial has been executed and no case has been posed. D-7 (execution authorisation) is NOT granted.
supersession_reason: owner amendment M3-T, decided BEFORE the first valid trial: M3 becomes a TRACED case, so the pidfd acquisition is established from the external syscall record instead of from a launcher field describing its own behaviour. No such receipt field was added and none is read. The traced set is amended prospectively from seven cases to eight - E1, E7, F4, F7, M1, M2, M3, M4 - while M3 stays CONDITIONAL on clone3_unavailable and the 72/54/11/7 partition is untouched. All 72 cases are now posable, up from 71. Wiring this also fixed a defect that predates it: driver.evaluate() never put the syscall record into the case record, so EVERY traced case would have scored INVALID at trial time. No C source byte changed, so the clean Build 5 compile evidence still covers the mechanism exactly. The superseded freezes 66bf4b6, 5729458, 575727f, a7ae6b9 and 4da94b5 are preserved unchanged.

traced_cases.note: a syscall record is collected ONLY for these cases. R, T, O, P and S cases are never traced, because ptrace notifies the tracer before the real parent and those cases measure the launcher's own waitid classification.
